title: Rationale for 75% Support Level from Households in Neighbourhood Renewal
what_it_is: Rationale for 75% Support Level from Households in Neighbourhood Renewal

sections.label: NRP resident support and timeline
sections.summary: NRP requires at least 75% resident support, and Town Councils should call tender within 12 months, though timing varies by project factors.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The requirement to have at least 75% support from residents before NRP proceeds provides certainty that the proposed improvements meet the needs of the majority of residents.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: It also promotes a sense of ownership for the proposed improvements and enhances residents' sense of belonging to their neighbourhood.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The recommended timeline for calling of tender for NRP works is within 12 months from announcement.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: This has been communicated to all Town Councils which carry out NRP.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In practice, however, the time taken varies from one project to another, and may not fall within the recommended timeline.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Factors that could affect the calling of tender include the size and complexity of the project, consultation processes adopted by Town Councils, and the extent of feedback and suggestions received from residents.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: As far as possible, Town Councils should expedite the NRP process where possible.

sections.label: NRP 75% support requirement
sections.summary: The requirement of at least 75% resident support for NRP ensures that the majority of residents support the proposal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As I said earlier, the requirement to achieve at least 75% support from residents for NRP is to ensure that residents, or the majority of the residents, indeed support the proposal.
